findings.message: Timer displays elapsed time: Covered by ElapsedTimeNonNegative lemma and Model.currentTime field
Single tap creates lap marker: Covered by CreateLap action
Each lap records duration from previous marker: Covered by CreateLap action implementation (duration := m.currentTime - m.lastLapTime)
Sessions organized hierarchically: Model structure with laps sequence covers this
Laps can be labeled with section name: Covered by LabelLap action
All takes preserved with timestamps and durations: Covered by Lap datatype with timestamp and duration fields
Users can manually select takes: Covered by SelectLap action and SelectLapToggles lemma
Users can delete unwanted takes: Covered by DeleteLap action and DeletePreservesDurations lemma
Users can manually adjust duration: Covered by AdjustDuration action and AdjustOnlyChangesDuration lemma
Total estimated duration computed by summing selected: Covered by SelectedTotal function and SelectedTotalCorrect lemma
Selected total equals sum of selected lap durations: Covered by SelectedTotalCorrect lemma
Selected total is non-negative: Covered by SelectedTotalNonNegative lemma
Moving lap up swaps with previous: Covered by MoveUp action and MoveUpSwaps lemma
Moving lap down swaps with next: Covered by MoveDown action and MoveDownSwaps lemma
Moving preserves all lap data: Covered by MoveUpSwaps/MoveDownSwaps lemmas (swaps preserve complete Lap objects)
Moving first lap up has no effect: Covered by MoveUpFirstNoEffect lemma
Moving last lap down has no effect: Covered by MoveDownLastNoEffect lemma
Starting practice captures section labels as template: Covered by SetTemplate action
Each lap in practice mode consumes one template entry: Covered by ConsumeTemplate action
Consumed template sets lap's section label: Covered by ConsumeTemplateSetsLabel lemma
Consumed template sets lap's expected duration: Covered by ConsumeTemplateSetsExpected lemma
Consumed template sets lap's tags: Covered by ConsumeTemplateSetsTags lemma
Template queue length decreases by one: Covered by ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue lemma
Consuming template sets all fields: Covered by ConsumeTemplateRoundTrip lemma
Consuming template preserves original lap duration: Covered by ConsumeTemplatePreservesDuration lemma
Consuming template preserves original lap timestamp: Covered by ConsumeTemplatePreservesTimestamp lemma
Reset in practice mode restores original template as laps: Covered by ResetRestoresOriginalTemplate lemma
Reset in practice mode clears both template and originalTemplate: Covered by ResetClearsTemplate lemma
Reset restores correct section from original template: Covered by ResetRestoresCorrectSections lemma
Reset restores correct tags from original template: Covered by ResetRestoresCorrectTags lemma
Importing laps preserves existing: Covered by ImportPreservesExisting lemma
Imported laps appended to end: Covered by ImportAppendsToEnd lemma
Import atomicity (single undo removes all): No direct Dafny lemma proves undo atomicity - this is a UI/runtime concern, not domain logic
Undo/redo system: No Dafny model for action history stack - this is likely handled by Kernel/Replay module externally
Each lap can have zero or more tags: Covered by Lap.tags field as seq<string>
Adding tag makes it present: Covered by AddTagAddsTag lemma
Removing tag makes it absent: Covered by RemoveTagRemovesTag lemma
Adding tag preserves other lap data: Covered by AddTagPreservesLapData lemma
Removing tag preserves other lap data: Covered by RemoveTagPreservesLapData lemma
SumByTag is non-negative: Covered by SumByTagNonNegative lemma
SumByTag only counts selected laps: Covered by SumByTagOnlySelected lemma
SumByTag only counts laps with specified tag: Covered by SumByTagOnlyTagged lemma
SumByTag includes duration when lap is selected and has tag: Covered by SumByTagIncludesDuration lemma
Domain complete: Model type defined with all required fields
Invariant predicate defined: Inv(m) properly constrains state
Action datatype covers all behaviors: All spec actions have corresponding Action variants
AppCore API exposes verified functions: SelectedTotal, SelectedCount, SumByTag, CountByTag, CollectAllTags
Orphan check: All lemmas correspond to spec items; no orphaned lemmas found
No axioms found in Domain.dfy - all [verified] items use proven lemmas

summary: All 51 verified spec items have corresponding lemmas; 2 minor warnings about undo/atomicity being runtime concerns rather than domain logic
